history.summary: A freehold 1,249 sqft 3BR (One Leicester, D13) just 300m from Potong Pasir MRT at $2.499M / $2,001 psf. Doorstep MRT and freehold are genuine strengths, but the asking sits at the very top of the project's recent $1,602-$2,013 psf transacted range, and the headline 11% CAGR is small-sample (22 txns) inflation — fully priced, not cheap.
history.rating_rationale: Web check: One Leicester (194-unit FH, 2009) transacted $1,602-$2,013 psf over the last year, avg ~$1,854. The $2,001 psf asking is at the top of that range and ~0.7% above the $1,987 URA median — no discount. The eye-catching 11% CAGR is a 22-txn artifact and not bankable. Doorstep Potong Pasir MRT (300m) and freehold tenure are real positives, and the strong frontier score (799) reflects them, but at $2.5M for a 3BR you are paying full price into the upper liquidity band — the upside is already in the price.
red_flags: $2,001 psf asking is at the TOP of the recent $1,602-$2,013 transacted range
11% CAGR from only 22 txns — small-sample inflation, not reliable
$2.5M quantum at the upper edge of the deep buyer band
Priced slightly above URA median — no value cushion
catalysts: 300m to Potong Pasir NE10 MRT — doorstep connectivity
Mature Potong Pasir/Macpherson estate with steady owner-occupier demand
